notes.title: Patch Notes 1.9.1.1
notes.notes:
- Ammo is now way cheaper, here how it works:

- Normal guns now costs 100 points to maximize ammo. This price will increase in decimal rounds. So after round 10 it will be 200, on 20 will be 300, and going on and on. (It was 250, and would increase from 5 to 5 rounds).
- Normal guns with upgrade now costs 250 to maximize ammo. The price will also increase in decimal rounds: 10 = 500, 20 = 750, 30 = 1000 (The old price was 1000 on round 10)
- Especial guns still costs 1000 points to maximize ammo, since they are very strong, but their price will also increase from 10 to 10 rounds: 10 = 2000, 20 = 3000


- Adressed a bug where the player could loose both guns when hitting a Laser Tower with a knife.

notes.title: 1.9 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
The next few months are going to be tough for me, as I am starting a new Job but I also need to keep this game updated, so a made a big update for now to keep you warm and cozy to wait for the next big update that will bring the next Map.

First I have a bad and a great new: The bad new is that I cancelled that brand new game mode "Incursions" because I though it would just cause more work for me to develop 2 modes at the same time. The Great new is that I've just fused that mode with the normal mode. So now you can be awarded with Artifacts in-game, that give you passive abilities like freezing enemies and exploding while reloading. There are also a new "event system" that will randomly spawn something for you to worry about middle-game, like a giant horde coming, or a tower that can slow you down. All of this "events" can award you with artifacts and powerups if you participate.

Here's everything that has changed:
-> Souls are now like coins, you need to collect them.
-> You can now SAVE 3 different guns and keep them to get back later on the hub (even if you die).
-> You can now use the Gun Upgrader Machine on the hub.
-> New Mission Menu
-> New Artifacts System
-> New Secret Quest Track system: You can now track the quests you are doing on each mission.
-> Forge is more random now.
-> Doors can now be permanently open, even if you extract. They only come back if you die.
-> If you extract with Power On, the power will be on again when you come back to that mission (if you didn't die before going back)
-> Some quests will change the map permanently after you've done it, even if you die.
-> Game Over screen updated.
-> There is no "Level" and "Xp" no more. Perks have no limit.

notes.title: Latest Patch (1.8.0.0)
notes.notes:
It's finally here! you can check all that was changed now:

HUD Improvments: The hud is way more "compatible" with Raven's Carnage vibe, with a more pixelated UI and more personality than ever. This include: Pause Menu, Game Over screen, and much more!

Incursion Mode: Incursion mode IS NOT available YET. But, you can already get 3 artifacts FOR FREE on the Main Hub, just find them and they'll be yours.

GamePad: I'm working on the 100% gamepad control, for now I would say that 95% of Raven's Carnage is playable now with only a controller! (There's just 1 or 2 menus that don't support it, but I'm currently working on it)

💥 - IMPORTANT CHANGES:

Monsters Health: Monsters were totally balanced in this update. Their total life was reduced by 50%, this will make so that you can kill them with only 1 knife until round 3. This way you can focus on what's really matter: CARNAGE and SECRET QUESTS. Also: Shooting monsters will now work on a very different way: They only shoot when they are next to you, so you won't have too much bullets going on your screen, there are lots of cases when they don't even shoot because you kill them fast enough. But this comes with a "trade-off": Monster projectiles are now 2x faster, so if they shoot it will be a little harder to escape (still very possible and fair, it's just more fast). On forsaken's specificaly: The game will give priority in spawning normal monsters, so you'll see less shooting monsters on that map!

There's no more character selection in Raven's Carnage. "Why you did this?" I know, I know, BUT this is important because Raven is the Main Character on Raven' s Carnage Story and I want him (and you, the player) to play an ESSENCIAL role in the hole story, and so you NEED to play with Raven in order for the story to progress in the way that it feels right. Also, the "Special Power" was removed, so Raven can no more reach that "demon form". BUT HOLD ON! The other characters will still make their way to Raven's Carnage, and you'll be able to find them, in any form: Bots, npcs and etc. They'll be part of secret quests and story. Also, I'm currently working on RAVEN COSTUMES, so yeah, you'll be able to change your appearence but it still will be Raven, but every costume can give you a small special or passive abilitie, so stay tuned on that! (For example: you can earn a Raven Knight costume for finishing forsaken's quest, in the next few updates!)

There's no more ANTIDOTE PERK. You are no longer able to increase your max life (just by buying a perk). This was made because the Antidote perk was pretty unbalanced and I don't think I would ever find a way to fit it in the game in a way that feels natural, so I taking it out and adding a brand new PowerUp drop: Life Maximizer (it maximizes your life). But you'll still be able to increase your max life (in other ways I'm still working on)

notes.title: Latest Patch 1.7.4.0
notes.notes:
What's new:

New Mode:
- Brand New Carnage Mode! Increase the aggression of the monsters. In this mode, Rounds go by faster and you won't have any breaks between them. Focus on what really matters: CARNAGE.

Rebalance:
- Soul spawn rate (when shooting monsters) is slightly increased (from 30 frames of "cooldown" to 20), this will allow players to earn a little bit more of points using guns with a high bullet cadence.

Graphic Improvement:
- Added a "camera shake" effect. (It happens when shooting with your gun, taking damage or activating the Carnage Mode)

GamePad support:
Gamepad support is not fully implemented yet, but there have already been significant improvements:
- The Aim is perfeclty adjusted now, so you can use the analog sticks to shoot them right in the face!
- Movement is now smooth as possible, with the analog sticks you can even control your speed.
- Vibration Implemented! Shoots and slides will now shake in your hands!
- Controller can pause the game now
- Controller support was still NOT added on menus, but it will, very soon.

Stay Tuned!

notes.title: Latest Patch 1.7.3.2
notes.notes:
Changes were made to facilitate the Forsaken's quest:

- The 4 thermometers are now $10, costing you a total of $440 to charge all of them them in any round. (It was $1.100). With this change you can start the first Main Quest step sooner in the game (the step where you need to be near a Fire Totem in the center of the castle) Doing it before round 6 will highly increase your chances of completing it easily.

- All of 4 Fire Charge Totens have now always 3000 health points (it was 2000 and could be reduced to 1000 if you failed your first time). This increase the resistence of the totens against monster projectiles and attacks, giving you more time to kill them.

notes.title: Latest Patch (1.7.1.0) (⚠ IMPORTANT)
notes.notes:
This patch is the most important one for now. And it comes with a "bad" consequence:

-> In this patch, I've just implemented something that should've been done in a long time: create a cryptography system for the save file. This needs to be done so I can assure a secure "Online Leaderboards" minimizing cheaters.

-> But that comes with a problem: it means that the old save file format won't be compactible anymore in any scenario. So what's probably gonna happen is that you're going to loose your save. That's why I did this update as fast as possible so that the game is in its "early" versions with only 2 maps and not so many things to progress right now.

-> I'm REALLY sorry for doing this, and as a apology, I'll be giving a free Mp40 instead of "Sally & Larry" for the rest of the lifespan of this version (1.7.1.x).

-> ALSO: if you already have a great save file, with lots of characters unlocked, or something like that and you don't want to lose it, you can get your save file from steam and send it to me on this email: hightwattstudio@gmail.com, I'll reply as soon as possible to return a valid save file for you.

-> That's it. Stay tuned and please let me know about how the game is going. Thanks for the pacience!

notes.title: Delay in the new update.
notes.notes:
Hello! I'm almost done with the next long-awaited update for Corpse Master Carnage! I'm implementing a LOT of new things and I'll need +1 week to be able to deliver all of them in perfect condition. Here are a few more things you'll find in the next update:

- You can now Knife monsters, just like the original Corpse Master. Knifing monsters will also give you more points than shooting.

- You can also upgrade your knife with a brand new beautiful Special Perk, available on the map "Hideout 116".

- You can now also run, just like in the original Corpse Master. Stamina can be increased to run further, by buying another brand new perk! Available on the maps: "Hideout 116" and "Forsaken".

- The GAME OVER screen was changed, and now will show your stats on a leaderboard, along with the other players in the match (when online is available)

- Im working on a way to REVIVE YOURSELF when you're playing solo.

- I'm also working on some brand new Easter Eggs, like getting secret guns, unlocking songs and etc...

Thank you for your patience and don't worry! The update will be available soon! See you on 06/14!
